name: AIMessage
description: plan-69 — one message/event in a conversation. A conversation is a Task (type="agent"); this row's taskId is the FK to that Task. Stores user input, assistant output, the model's tool-call/tool-response trace, and compaction summaries. Single source of truth for UI rendering (filter role IN ('user','assistant')) and pod context replay (load all WHERE compacted=false). Named AIMessage (NOT 'Message' — that collides with app-defined messaging entities); superseded AgentMessage; conversationId/conversationUuid dropped (the parent is taskId) and turnIndex renamed to seq. Explicit tableName ai_message_tbl.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owner — denormalized from the parent Task (the conversation). Populated by the agent runtime / AOS bridge on insert. representsOwnership drives the ownership filter (52-D.2 / 52-D.3) so direct /data/Message reads stay scoped.

attributes.name: taskId
attributes.description: plan-69 — FK to the conversation Task (task_tbl, type="agent"). Replaces AgentMessage.conversationId.

attributes.name: uuid
attributes.description: Parquet-friendly natural key. UUIDv4 set at INSERT by the producer (pod for tool_* / assistant / summary rows; AOS for user rows). Stable for the row's lifetime.

attributes.name: seq
attributes.description: plan-69 — stable ordering within the conversation (1, 2, 3, ...). Was AgentMessage.turnIndex.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: What kind of event this row records. user/assistant are user-facing turns (the UI streams these). tool_call / tool_response make up the model's chronological trace within a turn. summary is a compaction artifact. UI filters role IN ('user','assistant'); pod replay loads everything WHERE compacted=false.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: 'action' is valid only when role=user (action-link click). 'error' is valid only when role=assistant — populated when the agent loop failed.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Markdown (assistant) or text/label (user)

attributes.name: executorKind
attributes.description: plan-69 — kind of the frame that emitted this message (function | agent). Needed once nested calls interleave events from the parent agent, sub-agents, and functions, and because a function `foo` and an agent `foo` can share a name.

attributes.name: executorName
attributes.description: plan-69 — name of the agent/function that emitted this message.

attributes.name: toolName
attributes.description: Function/agent name being called. Set on tool_call (the callee the model wants to invoke) and tool_response (the callee whose result we're recording). NULL on user/assistant/summary rows.

attributes.name: toolKind
attributes.description: plan-69 — kind of the callee on tool_call / tool_response (function | agent), alongside toolName.

attributes.name: toolArgs
attributes.description: Args dict for tool_call rows. NULL otherwise.

attributes.name: toolResult
attributes.description: Result payload for tool_response rows. May be large (entity rows, query results) — jsonb keeps Postgres happy and compresses well via TOAST. NULL otherwise.

attributes.name: output
attributes.description: Schema-validated structured output for an assistant turn, extracted by the runtime when the agent declares an outputSchema. Carries the collected/derived data separately from the conversational text in content. NULL when no outputSchema, on non-assistant rows, or when extraction failed. Read-only to API callers.

attributes.name: actionIntent
attributes.description: Verb when kind=action (e.g., compose_reply)

attributes.name: actionParams
attributes.description: Action params dict when kind=action

attributes.name: actionLabel
attributes.description: Displayed link label when kind=action

attributes.name: tokenCount
attributes.description: Tokens this row contributes to the prompt context. Computed at INSERT so the compaction trigger can SUM(tokenCount) WHERE compacted=false without re-tokenizing.

attributes.name: compacted
attributes.description: Set to true on rows replaced by a downstream 'summary' row during compaction. Pod context-load filters WHERE compacted=false. Originals stay for audit.

attributes.name: clientMessageId
attributes.description: Client-generated UUID for idempotent persistence. Pod attaches a fresh UUID per published 'persist' event; the AOS bridge dedups across multi-instance pub/sub fanout. NULL for rows written without it — Postgres UNIQUE treats each NULL as distinct.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Structured error block {code, message} when kind=error. NULL on success rows.

attributes.name: hasAttachment
attributes.description: plan-57/69 — true when this message has at least one File2 row pointing to it (sourceClass='Message', sourceId=<this.id>). Set when persisting a user turn with attachmentFileIds.
